_comment: DeePMD-kit v2/v3 training input for a water + NaCl + 2D-membrane system. Train on DFT (QE/CP2K) energies+forces exported to the DeePMD 'raw'/'npy' format via dpdata. The descriptor below (se_e2_a, i.e. DeepPot-SE) is the workhorse for aqueous/interface systems; MACE/NequIP are strong alternatives handled by separate configs.

descriptor._comment: rcut=6.0 A captures the first two solvation shells; raise to 7-8 A if long-range ordering matters.

loss._comment: Force-weighted early (start_pref_f high) so the model nails the forces that drive MD stability, then anneals toward energy accuracy.

training_data._comment: Include high-pressure and pore-confined frames, not just bulk water, or the MLP will extrapolate badly under the NEMD piston.
